body:
I am surprised and happy with the experience I had with nutmeg!
I have only taken weed once and drank alcohol, this was my only basis to go off.
I had done a weeks worth of research on recipes, prep tips, and side effects. Honestly it sounded 50/50 on being a good or bad experience, but I decided why not. I figured the best way to ingest it was oral as most others had said and by using ground fresh nuts. Me and a friend (he was tall 64 and 160 lbs) he had taken drugs like LSD and Acid so I trusted him.
My Method: worlds worst holiday coffee
*The key is the oil*
I bought 2 lbs of whole nutmeg nuts (way too much)
Took out about 10 nuts per person
Crushed them with nut crackers and then pulverized them as small as possible
Put in blender with a little water (I dont think the water helped me get high)
Put on pan with more water and light boiled for a while (10-15 mins)
Took out and tried to strain it more then put into another pan with a lil more water boiled again
Repeated until it was a buttery liquid not a paste
Tried to put through a coffee filter but decided it was soaking up too much oil (dont lose the oil!)
Poured into a mug took with some coffee
Enjoy a bitter ass coffee!
I think I should say that it took a long time to get it down to a liquid and was very messy and smelly and I left it overnight cuz I got tired and it took a long time, I think if I freeze it or even cool it I can separate the oil without boiling and filtering. We both took 3 spoonfuls of oily sludge and put into a mug.
It started at 1045 AM: Me and my friend took it in our coffee, was very bitter, but the coffee and oil helps. Initially I just felt like it was gonna be dangerous but actually taking it made me feel like nothing was going to happen. Me and my friend left to get breakfast lots of burps on the drive over, during this there were many happy moments but I think it was mostly just excitement.
1145ish Our food took a long time and we started to feel a pressure in our chests I felt like it was like being deep under water but just in my chest and stomach.
1230 We got back and I definitely started to feel it creep up on me and then go away like little bubbles popping very nice feeling but short.
1300 At this point I didnt feel anything but a nice mellow I started having trouble remembering what I wanted to do and even felt a slightly horny.
1400 Now I was lying on my bed listening to music and smiling at every little detail. It felt like everything I touched felt good to feel and the music I listened to felt a little trippy
I was lying on my bed listening to music and smiling at every little detail. It felt like everything I touched felt good to feel and the music I listened to felt a little trippy
but nothing more than a hit of mj wouldnt do.
1430-1730 At this point I wasnt keeping track of time I kept getting up and stretching all my muscles and it felt very nice like a good massage. I tried to listen to some music that might help me trip with my eyes closed, my friend said he did hallucinate and he had many auditory hallucinations,
Only at one point I felt like I was swimming under water and fish were swimming next to me. The music just carried me like a wave deep underwater.
1730-till next morning. At this point the peak, only lasting 1-2 hours, was over and I felt very comfy.
For a first time I would say if I had taken it while drunk or high it would have felt amazing by itself. However, I couldnt tell if I was high or not except during the peak. I never saw anything move or distort so a little disappointed.
My friend said it felt like a diet molly, not very strong and it didnt force me to do things. We both didnt feel any real noticeable hangover other than a little lethargic and didn't have any crazy dreams.
I would do it again but maybe supplement with alcohol, happy trails!
